```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

theme_set(theme_classic())

data_dir   = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_processed_data"
net_dir    = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results/netMHC"
result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"

get_header <- function(fnm){
  header = data.frame(fread(fnm, nrows = 2, header = TRUE, strip.white = FALSE))
  w_HLA = grep("^(HLA|DR)", names(header))
  steps = unique(w_HLA[-1] - w_HLA[-length(w_HLA)])
  
  if(length(steps) > 1){
    stop("step should have only one value!")
  }
  
  HLAs = rep("", ncol(header))
  
  for(w1 in w_HLA){
    HLAs[w1:(w1+steps-1)] = paste0(names(header)[w1], "_")
  }
  
  header_names = paste0(HLAs, header[1,])
  header_names = gsub("-", "_", header_names)
}

extract_14 = function(z){
  xx = min(14 - nchar(z[1]), nchar(z[2]))
  paste(z[1], substr(z[2], 1, xx), sep = "_")
}

get_identity <- function(x, appendix){
  parts <- strsplit(paste(gsub("*", "_", x, fixed = TRUE), appendix, sep = "_"), ":")

  # Combine the first three parts
  result <- sapply(parts, extract_14)
  result
}

get_binders <- function(df1){
  EL_rank = grep("_Rank$", names(df1), value = TRUE)
  HLAs = gsub("_Rank", "", EL_rank)
  
  res = NULL
  
  for(i in 1:length(HLAs)){
    w1 = which(df1[[EL_rank[i]]] < 2)
    
    if(length(w1) > 0){
      cols = c("Pos", "Peptide", "ID", 
               paste0(HLAs[i], c("_Score", "_Rank")))
      df_i = data.frame(df1[w1,cols,drop=FALSE])
      names(df_i)[4:5] = c("EL_Score", "EL_Rank")
      df_i$HLA = HLAs[i]
      
      res = rbind(res, df_i)
    }
  }
  res
}

```

## Read in NetMHC results

### Read and combine mutated peptide results
```{r}
fnm = file.path(net_dir, "NetMHCIIpan_4.3i_mut_DR.xls")
nm_mut = data.frame(fread(fnm, col.names = get_header(fnm), skip = 2))
dim(nm_mut)
nm_mut[1:2, c(1:8, (ncol(nm_mut) - 5):ncol(nm_mut))]

fnm = file.path(net_dir, "NetMHCIIpan_4.3i_mut_DQ.xls")
nm_mut_Q = data.frame(fread(fnm, col.names = get_header(fnm), skip = 2))
dim(nm_mut_Q)
nm_mut_Q[1:2, c(1:8, (ncol(nm_mut_Q) - 5):ncol(nm_mut_Q))]

fnm = file.path(net_dir, "NetMHCIIpan_4.3i_mut_DP.xls")
nm_mut_P = data.frame(fread(fnm, col.names = get_header(fnm), skip = 2))
dim(nm_mut_P)
nm_mut_P[1:2, c(1:8, (ncol(nm_mut_P) - 5):ncol(nm_mut_P))]

stopifnot(all(nm_mut$Peptide == nm_mut_Q$Peptide))
stopifnot(all(nm_mut$Peptide == nm_mut_P$Peptide))

cols2rm = c("Ave", "NB", "Target")
nm_mut = merge(nm_mut[,-which(names(nm_mut) %in% cols2rm)], 
               nm_mut_Q[,-which(names(nm_mut_Q) %in% cols2rm)], 
               by = c("Pos", "Peptide", "ID"))
dim(nm_mut)
nm_mut[1:2, c(1:8, (ncol(nm_mut) - 5):ncol(nm_mut))]

nm_mut = merge(nm_mut, 
               nm_mut_P[,-which(names(nm_mut_P) %in% cols2rm)], 
               by = c("Pos", "Peptide", "ID"))
dim(nm_mut)
nm_mut[1:2, c(1:8, (ncol(nm_mut) - 5):ncol(nm_mut))]

```

## Extract binders

```{r}
binders_mut = get_binders(nm_mut)
binders_ref = get_binders(nm_ref)

dim(binders_mut)
dim(binders_ref)

binders_mut[1:4,]
binders_ref[1:4,]

summary(binders_mut$EL_Score)
summary(binders_ref$EL_Score)

binders = merge(binders_mut, binders_ref, by = c("Pos", "ID", "HLA"), 
                all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE, suffixes = c("_mut", "_ref"))

dim(binders)
binders[1:2,]
table(is.na(binders$EL_Rank_mut))
table(is.na(binders$EL_Rank_ref))

binders$EL_Rank_ref[is.na(binders$EL_Rank_ref)] = 2.5

table(binders$Peptide_mut == binders$Peptide_ref)

binders = binders[-which(binders$Peptide_mut == binders$Peptide_ref),]
dim(binders)
binders[1:2,]

table(binders$HLA)
binders$HLA = gsub("^HLA\\.", "", binders$HLA)
table(binders$HLA)

binders$HLA_gene = substr(binders$HLA, 1, 2)

ggplot(binders, aes(x = EL_Rank_ref, y = EL_Rank_mut, col = HLA_gene)) + 
  geom_point() + 
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", 
                color = "gray40", linewidth = 1)

ggplot(binders, aes(x = EL_Rank_mut, y = EL_Score_mut, col = HLA_gene)) + 
  geom_point()


```

```{r fig.width = 8, fig.height=6}
binders = merge(binders, mut_dat0, by = "ID")
dim(binders)
binders[1:2,]

binders <- binders %>%
  mutate(EL_Rank_diff = EL_Rank_mut - EL_Rank_ref)

binders_reduced <- binders %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(
    EL_Rank_diff = max(EL_Rank_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    EL_Rank_mut = min(EL_Rank_mut, na.rm = TRUE),
    EL_Rank_ref = min(EL_Rank_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    Freq        = unique(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    neoantigen  = unique(neoantigen, na.rm = TRUE),
    nTCRA       = unique(nTCRA, na.rm = TRUE),
    nTCRB       = unique(nTCRB, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


library(patchwork)  # for arranging multiple plots

# Scatter: Freq vs EL_Rank_mut
p1 <- ggplot(binders_reduced, aes(x = log10(Freq), y = EL_Rank_mut)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "log10(Freq)", y = "EL Rank (mutation)")

# Scatter: nTCRA vs EL_Rank_mut
p2 <- ggplot(binders_reduced, aes(x = nTCRA, y = EL_Rank_mut)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "nTCRA", y = "EL Rank (mutation)")

# Scatter: nTCRB vs EL_Rank_mut
p3 <- ggplot(binders_reduced, aes(x = nTCRB, y = EL_Rank_mut)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "nTCRB", y = "EL Rank (mutation)")

# Boxplot: EL_Rank_ref vs neoantigen
p4 <- ggplot(binders_reduced, aes(x = as.factor(neoantigen), y = EL_Rank_mut, 
                                  fill = neoantigen)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  labs(x = "Neoantigen", y = "EL Rank (mutation)")

# Combine all plots
(p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)



# Scatter: EL_diff vs Freq
p1 <- ggplot(binders_reduced, aes(x = log10(Freq), y = EL_Rank_diff)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "log10(Freq)", y = "EL_Rank diff")

# Scatter: EL_diff vs nTCRA
p2 <- ggplot(binders_reduced, aes(x = nTCRA, y = EL_Rank_diff)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "nTCRA", y = "EL_Rank diff")

# Scatter: EL_diff vs nTCRB
p3 <- ggplot(binders_reduced, aes(x = nTCRB, y = EL_Rank_diff)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "nTCRB", y = "EL_Rank diff")

# Boxplot: EL_diff vs neoantigen
p4 <- ggplot(binders_reduced, aes(x = as.factor(neoantigen), y = EL_Rank_diff, 
                                  fill = neoantigen)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  labs(x = "Neoantigen", y = "EL_Rank diff")

# Combine all plots into one figure
(p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)


table(table(binders$ID))
table(binders$neoantigen, binders$EL_Rank_mut < binders$EL_Rank_ref)

fwrite(binders, file.path(net_dir, "binders_HLA_II.csv"))
```


# Prioritize neoantigens for validation

## Select those with high scores
```{r}
table(binders$EL_Score_mut > 0.25, binders$EL_Rank_mut < 1)
table(binders$EL_Score_mut > 0.25, binders$EL_Rank_diff < 0)

grp1 = binders[binders$EL_Score_mut > 0.25 & binders$EL_Rank_mut < 1,]
dim(grp1)

cols = c("ID", "key", "key_pro", "HLA", "Peptide_mut", "EL_Score_mut")
cols = c(cols, "EL_Rank_mut", "Peptide_ref", "EL_Score_ref", "EL_Rank_ref")
cols = c(cols, "wildtype", "mutant", "Pos")
cols = c(cols, "cancer", "auc", "nTCRA", "nTCRB", "neoantigen", "Freq")

cols2show = c("ID", "HLA", "Peptide_mut", "EL_Score_mut", "EL_Score_ref", 
              "cancer", "auc", "nTCRA", "nTCRB", "neoantigen", "Freq")

grp1 = grp1[,cols]
grp1[order(grp1$Freq, decreasing = TRUE), cols2show]

fwrite(grp1, file.path(net_dir, "binders_HLA_II_filtered.csv"))

```
